description: Load this skill whenever the project has personalization features, user preference controls, theme selectors, font size adjusters, motion toggles, contrast settings, or any user-configurable accessibility accommodations. Under no circumstances override or ignore user OS-level accessibility preferences without explicit user consent. Absolutely always persist user preferences, apply them immediately, and respect prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-contrast, and similar media queries.
